# Tree Service

## Purpose
The Tree Service provides a specialized infrastructure for managing and querying hierarchical data structures (trees). It allows any system entity to be organized into a tree format, supporting operations like parent-child relationships, branch navigation, and hierarchical filtering.

## Endpoints

| Controller | Endpoint | Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tree** | `/plugins/Tree/getAllTrees` | POST | Lists all root trees. |
| **TreeNode** | `/plugins/TreeNode/getAllTreeNodes` | POST | Lists nodes for a specific tree or parent. |
| **TreeNode** | `/plugins/TreeNode/createTreeNode` | POST | Adds a new node to a tree. |

## Dependencies
- **tree-model**: Core hierarchical data structures.
- **flexicore-boot**: Plugin infrastructure.

## Interesting Features
- **Recursive Structure**: Native support for infinite nesting through parent-child node relationships.
- **User-Specific Nodes**: Integration with `TreeNodeToUser` to manage visibility or ownership of specific branches.

## Operation Flow
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Controller as TreeNodeController
    participant Service as TreeService

    User->>Controller: createTreeNode(TreeNodeCreate)
    Controller->>Service: createTreeNode(TreeNodeCreate)
    Service-->>User: Node Created with Parent Link
```
